In-app AI assistant chat interface (React)

Embed a production-grade chat and agent UI in a React application: streaming messages, tool calls, attachments and formatted assistant output. Evaluate the assistant-ui suite both as direct imports and as the transitive dependency tree they bring in.

Owner: frontend-platformCadence: 90 daysCreated 27 Oct 20265 candidates
Decision ApprovedActive

Adopt @assistant-ui/react

The entry point and the only package most apps import. Supply chain is strong: OIDC trusted publishing, SLSA provenance, no install scripts anywhere in the 183-package tree. The costs are 10 direct dependencies, a 54 MB install, about 135 KB gzip, and 0.x churn of roughly 30 releases per quarter.

Constraints

  • Permissive license across the full dependency tree
  • CI-published with verifiable provenance
  • Bundled TypeScript types
  • No install scripts in the dependency tree
  • No telemetry or network calls unless explicitly configured
  • React 18 and 19 supported

Out of scope

  • Visual design and theming
  • LLM provider selection
  • Prompt and agent design

Decision rationale

Adopt @assistant-ui/react as the single direct dependency, plus @assistant-ui/react-markdown only if formatted assistant output is required. @assistant-ui/core, @assistant-ui/tap and @assistant-ui/store arrive transitively and must be allowlisted because they are required peers, not optional extras; @assistant-ui/store was missing from the original four-package list. All five are MIT, provenance-signed, free of install scripts and advisories, and the repository publishes through OIDC trusted publishing with a protected environment. The residual risks are footprint (63 MB full install, about 135 KB gzip) and 0.x churn (roughly 30 releases per quarter), so pin exact versions, import only from @assistant-ui/react, keep rehype-raw disabled, and re-review on the 90-day cadence.

Review timeline

  1. 27 Oct 2026 @assistant-ui/react-markdown Adopt Optional markdown renderer built on react-markdown 10.1. Adopt only if formatted assistant output is needed: it adds about 87 packages and 72 KB gzip. Raw HTML is off by default, so the XSS surface is react-markdown's standard one.
  2. 27 Oct 2026 @assistant-ui/tap Adopt React's hook engine reimplemented so hooks can run outside a React tree. Zero dependencies, 752 KB unpacked, provenance-signed, and required as a peer by core and store. Novel enough to warrant review, but not code you import directly.
  3. 27 Oct 2026 @assistant-ui/core Adopt Required runtime beneath @assistant-ui/react; you get it automatically. Same pipeline and provenance, only three runtime dependencies, but it ships source and source maps, which makes the installed package 9.9 MB unpacked.
  4. 27 Oct 2026 @assistant-ui/store Adopt Required peer of core and react, and the only addition beyond the four requested packages. Zero dependencies, provenance-signed, 1.1M weekly downloads, same maintainers. You never import it directly.
  5. 27 Oct 2026 @assistant-ui/react Adopt The entry point and the only package most apps import.
